items.title: PlugMem: A Task-Agnostic Plugin Memory Module for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: PlugMem：面向 LLM 智能体的任务无关插件式记忆模块
items.summary: PlugMem is a task-agnostic plug-in memory module that structures episodic memories into a compact, extensible knowledge-centric memory graph of propositional and prescriptive knowledge, making knowledge rather than entities or text chunks the unit of memory access. Across conversational QA, multi-hop retrieval and web-agent benchmarks it beats task-agnostic baselines and task-specific memory designs while achieving the highest information density, with code released.

items.title: "Humans welcome to observe": A First Look at the Agent Social Network Moltbook
items.title_zh: “人类欢迎旁观”：智能体社交网络 Moltbook 初探
items.summary: The authors analyze 44,411 posts and 12,209 sub-communities from Moltbook, a social network designed exclusively for AI agents, collected before February 1, 2026. They find explosive growth and diversification into viewpoint, incentive-driven, promotional and political discourse, topic-dependent toxicity, and bursty automation that can flood the platform at sub-minute intervals.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex
items.title_zh: GPT-5.3-Codex 发布
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.3-Codex, a Codex-native agent that pairs frontier coding performance with general reasoning to support long-horizon, real-world technical work.

items.title: LOCA-bench: Benchmarking Language Agents Under Controllable and Extreme Context Growth
items.title_zh: LOCA-bench：在可控且极端上下文增长下评测语言智能体
items.summary: LOCA-bench evaluates language agents under controllable, potentially unbounded context growth by automatically regulating environment states while keeping task semantics fixed. It scores model-plus-scaffold combinations, including context-management strategies, and finds that performance generally degrades as environment states grow more complex while advanced context management substantially improves success rates; the benchmark is open-sourced.

items.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.title_zh: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.summary: Qwen published a blog post on Qwen3-Coder-Next; the page describes Qwen's broader feature set, including chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: DoubleTake: Contrastive Reasoning for Faithful Decision-Making in Medical Imaging
items.title_zh: DoubleTake：医学影像中忠实决策的对比推理
items.summary: DoubleTake builds compact, document-aware reference sets that optimize for discrimination rather than similarity by balancing visual relevance, embedding diversity and source-level provenance, and releases a reproducible selection protocol and curated reference bank. Its Counterfactual-Contrastive Inference framework reports state-of-the-art set-level accuracy on MediConfusion, nearly 15% relative above prior methods, with faithful abstention.

items.title: AgentArk: Distilling Multi-Agent Intelligence into a Single LLM Agent
items.title_zh: AgentArk：将多智能体智能蒸馏进单一 LLM 智能体
items.summary: AgentArk distills multi-agent debate dynamics into the weights of a single model through three hierarchical strategies: reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning, trajectory-based augmentation and process-aware distillation. The distilled agents keep single-agent inference cost while retaining multi-agent reasoning and self-correction, with reported robustness and generalization gains across reasoning tasks.

items.title: Agentic AI in Healthcare & Medicine: A Seven-Dimensional Taxonomy for Empirical Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
items.title_zh: 医疗与医学中的智能体 AI：评估 LLM 智能体的七维分类法
items.summary: The review maps 49 studies of LLM-based healthcare agents onto a seven-dimensional taxonomy with 29 operational sub-dimensions and a three-level implementation rubric. It finds external knowledge integration fully implemented in about 76% of studies, event-triggered activation absent in about 92% and drift detection absent in about 98%, with multi-agent designs dominant but orchestration mostly partial.

items.title: Decomposed Prompting Does Not Fix Knowledge Gaps, But Helps Models Say "I Don't Know"
items.title_zh: 分解式提示无法修复知识缺口，但能帮助模型说“我不知道”
items.summary: The authors compare Direct, Assistive and Incremental prompting across model scales and multi-hop QA benchmarks, finding that accuracy gains from decomposition diminish in frontier models. Disagreement between regimes remains a precise uncertainty signal, and a training-free abstention policy based on it improves F1 and AUROC over standard uncertainty baselines without retrieval or fine-tuning.

items.title: Locas: Your Models are Principled Initializers of Locally-Supported Parametric Memories
items.title_zh: Locas：你的模型是局部支持参数化记忆的原则性初始化器
items.summary: Locas is a locally supported parametric memory shaped like transformer FFN blocks that can be offloaded from or merged into model parameters, supporting efficient continual learning. Initialized from model parameters, activations or gradients, Locas-GLU stores past context with as little as 0.02% additional parameters on PG-19 and LoCoMo while limiting catastrophic forgetting in MMLU tests.

items.title: GRP-Obliteration: Unaligning LLMs With a Single Unlabeled Prompt
items.title_zh: GRP-Obliteration：用单个无标签提示解除 LLM 对齐
items.summary: GRP-Obliteration uses Group Relative Policy Optimization to remove safety constraints from aligned models with a single unlabeled prompt while largely preserving utility, reporting stronger average unalignment than prior techniques. It is evaluated on six utility and five safety benchmarks across fifteen 7–20B models from GPT-OSS, distilled DeepSeek, Gemma, Llama, Ministral and Qwen, and also unaligns diffusion-based image models.

items.title: Learning Query-Aware Budget-Tier Routing for Runtime Agent Memory
items.title_zh: 面向运行时智能体记忆的查询感知预算分层路由学习
items.summary: BudgetMem structures runtime agent memory as modules offered in Low, Mid and High budget tiers, with a lightweight RL-trained router that performs per-query budget-tier routing to balance task performance and construction cost. Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval and HotpotQA it surpasses strong baselines in high-budget settings and yields better accuracy-cost frontiers under tighter budgets, while comparing implementation, reasoning and capacity tiering.

items.title: Adaptive Retrieval helps Reasoning in LLMs -- but mostly if it's not used
items.title_zh: 自适应检索有助于大模型推理——但主要是在不使用检索时
items.summary: The authors compare an LLM agent that decides when to query an external knowledge base against chain-of-thought and static retrieval on GSM8K and MATH-500. Static retrieval underperformed CoT, and traces without retrieval actually did better than CoT, suggesting retrieval only rarely helps reasoning and that choosing not to retrieve is a useful metacognitive signal; retrieval frequency scaled with problem difficulty.

items.title: Multi-Agentic AI for Fairness-Aware and Accelerated Multi-modal Large Model Inference in Real-world Mobile Edge Networks
items.title_zh: 面向移动边缘网络多模态大模型推理的多智能体公平加速框架
items.summary: The paper proposes a multi-agent framework with a long-term global planning agent, a short-term prompt scheduling agent and on-node deployment agents that reason in natural language over runtime telemetry to route prompts and place multimodal models in mobile edge networks. On a city-wide testbed it reduces average end-to-end latency by 42.9% versus an online-learning baseline and 80.6% versus full activation, maintaining a mean service-type Jain's index of 0.925.

items.title: AD-MIR: Bridging the Gap from Perception to Persuasion in Advertising Video Understanding via Structured Reasoning
items.title_zh: AD-MIR：通过结构化推理弥合广告视频理解中的感知与说服鸿沟
items.summary: AD-MIR builds a structure-aware memory from raw advertising video by combining semantic retrieval with exact keyword matching, then uses a structured reasoning agent that decomposes the narrative and validates insights against specific frames with evidence-based self-correction. On the AdsQA benchmark it surpasses the strongest general-purpose agent by 1.8% strict and 9.5% relaxed accuracy.

items.title: Efficient Table Retrieval and Understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 基于多模态大模型的高效表格检索与理解
items.summary: TabRAG answers queries over large collections of table images by retrieving candidate tables with jointly trained visual-text foundation models, reranking them with MLLMs, then reasoning over the selected tables. On a newly constructed dataset of 88,161 training and 9,819 test samples across eight benchmarks it improves retrieval recall by 7.0% and answer accuracy by 6.1%.

items.title: CrossTraffic: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible and Executable Transportation Analysis and Knowledge Management
items.title_zh: CrossTraffic：可复现可执行的交通分析与知识管理开源框架
items.summary: CrossTraffic treats transportation methodologies and regulatory knowledge as continuously deployable, verifiable software infrastructure, combining an executable computational core, an ontology-driven knowledge graph that encodes engineering rules and provenance, and a conversational LLM interface that uses structured tool invocation. Knowledge-graph-constrained execution achieved near-zero numerical error (MAE below 0.50) across multiple LLMs and perfect detection of invalid analytical inputs (F1 approximately 1.0).

items.title: Generative AI in Action: Field Experimental Evidence from Alibaba's Customer Service Operations
items.title_zh: 生成式 AI 实践：来自阿里巴巴客服运营的现场实验证据
items.summary: In a large-scale field experiment with Alibaba after-sales chat agents, a generative AI assistant drafted issue diagnoses and solution proposals in the opening stage while agents could adopt, modify or disregard them. On average it improved service speed and subjective ratings without a significant effect on objective quality; lower-performing agents benefited most, while top performers saw declines consistent with workflow disruption.

items.title: TAAM:Inductive Graph-Class Incremental Learning with Task-Aware Adaptive Modulation
items.title_zh: TAAM：面向归纳式图类增量学习的任务感知自适应调制
items.summary: TAAM freezes a shared GNN backbone and trains a lightweight Neural Synapse Modulator per task as an expert module, keeping new knowledge in compact task-specific modules to avoid catastrophic forgetting without data replay. It also introduces Anchored Multi-hop Propagation for unknown task IDs, and reports gains over state-of-the-art methods on eight datasets under a stricter inductive protocol that avoids leakage found in existing benchmarks.

items.title: "I May Not Have Articulated Myself Clearly": Diagnosing Dynamic Instability in LLM Reasoning at Inference Time
items.title_zh: “我可能没表达清楚”：诊断大模型推理的推理时动态不稳定性
items.summary: The study defines an instability signal combining consecutive-step Jensen–Shannon divergence and entropy from standard token log probabilities, requiring no training or fine-tuning. Across GSM8K and HotpotQA it predicts wrong answers above chance and distinguishes early corrective instability from late destructive instability, which more often precedes failure.

items.title: LABBench2: An Improved Benchmark for AI Systems Performing Biology Research
items.title_zh: LABBench2：评估 AI 系统开展生物学研究的改进基准
items.summary: LABBench2 contains nearly 1,900 tasks that extend LAB-Bench toward more realistic scientific work, measuring capabilities beyond rote knowledge and reasoning. Frontier models show substantial improvement over the original benchmark but a meaningful jump in difficulty, with model-specific accuracy drops of 26% to 46% across subtasks; the dataset and public eval harness are released.

items.title: InftyThink+: Effective and Efficient Infinite-Horizon Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: InftyThink+：通过强化学习实现高效无限视野推理
items.summary: InftyThink+ is an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that trains a model to choose when to summarize intermediate thoughts, what to preserve and how to resume reasoning, using a supervised cold-start followed by trajectory-level RL. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B it improves AIME24 accuracy by 21%, outperforms conventional long chain-of-thought RL by a clear margin and reduces inference latency.

items.title: Small Agent Group is the Future of Digital Health
items.title_zh: 小型智能体团队是数字健康的未来
items.summary: The paper challenges a scaling-first approach to clinical AI and proposes a Small Agent Group that distributes reasoning, evidence-based analysis and critical audit across a collaborative deliberation process. Evaluations spanning effectiveness, reliability and deployment cost show the group outperforms a single giant model both with and without additional optimization or retrieval-augmented generation.

items.title: anbeime/skill
items.title_zh: anbeime/skill：AI Agent 技能库与 Skills 商店
items.summary: The repository is a Python-based AI agent skill library offering curated, installable skill packs for document processing, content creation, programming, machine learning and automated workflows, plus an index of GitHub skill projects sorted by category, update time and stars.

items.title: BlockRunAI/ClawRouter
items.title_zh: BlockRunAI/ClawRouter：面向自主智能体的 LLM 路由器
items.summary: ClawRouter is described as an agent-native LLM router that puts every frontier model behind one wallet, with sub-millisecond local routing and USDC payments on Base and Solana via x402.

items.title: GAMMS: Graph based Adversarial Multiagent Modeling Simulator
items.title_zh: GAMMS：基于图的多智能体对抗建模模拟器
items.summary: GAMMS is a lightweight, extensible open-source simulator for multi-agent behavior in graph-representable environments such as urban road networks and communication systems. It supports heuristic, optimization-based and learning-based agents, including LLM-based ones, and integrates with machine learning libraries and planning solvers.

items.title: google-gemini/gemini-skills
items.title_zh: google-gemini/gemini-skills：面向 Gemini API 与 Agent 的技能集
items.summary: A Python repository that provides skills for the Gemini API, SDK and model or agent interactions.

items.title: op7418/CodePilot
items.title_zh: op7418/CodePilot：多模型 AI Agent 桌面客户端
items.summary: CodePilot is a multi-model AI agent desktop client built with Electron and Next.js that can connect to any AI provider, be extended with MCP and skills, and be controlled from a phone.

items.title: matt1398/claude-devtools
items.title_zh: matt1398/claude-devtools：Claude Code 的开发者工具
items.summary: Claude DevTools is a free, open-source TypeScript tool with a visual interface for inspecting Claude Code session logs, tool calls, token usage, subagents and context window.

items.title: fynnfluegge/agtx
items.title_zh: fynnfluegge/agtx：面向编码智能体的黑板式开发环境
items.summary: agtx is a Rust-based "blackboard" and agentic development environment for coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and Grok.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex
items.title_zh: GPT-5.3-Codex 发布
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.3-Codex, a Codex-native agent that pairs frontier coding performance with general reasoning to support long-horizon, real-world technical work.

items.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.title_zh: Qwen3-Coder-Next
items.summary: Qwen published a blog post on Qwen3-Coder-Next; the page describes Qwen's broader feature set, including chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: Nemotron ColEmbed V2: Top-Performing Late Interaction Embedding Models for Visual Document Retrieval
items.title_zh: Nemotron ColEmbed V2：面向视觉文档检索的顶级晚交互嵌入模型
items.summary: Nemotron ColEmbed V2 is a family of vision-language embedding models at 3B, 4B and 8B parameters, built on Eagle 2 with a Llama 3.2 3B backbone and Qwen3-VL backbones, for visual document retrieval. The 8B model ranks first on the ViDoRe V3 leaderboard as of February 3, 2026 with average NDCG@10 of 63.42, and the work details cluster-based sampling, hard-negative mining, late interaction and model merging.

items.title: Introducing the Codex app
items.title_zh: 推出 Codex 应用：面向 AI 编程的指挥中心
items.summary: OpenAI introduced a Codex app for macOS that acts as a command center for AI coding and software development, with multiple agents, parallel workflows and long-running tasks.

items.title: Agent Skills
items.title_zh: Agent Skills：标准化的智能体技能
items.summary: The Agent Skills site describes a standardized way to give AI agents new capabilities and expertise.

items.title: How does misalignment scale with model intelligence and task complexity?
items.title_zh: 失准如何随模型智能和任务复杂度扩展？
items.summary: Research from the first Anthropic Fellows Program, run in summer 2025, separates frontier reasoning model errors into systematic bias and incoherent variance. It finds that failures are increasingly dominated by incoherence as tasks get harder and reasoning runs longer.

items.title: Skills vs MCP tools for agents: when to use what
items.title_zh: 智能体技能与 MCP 工具：何时使用哪一种
items.summary: The LlamaIndex blog post compares Skills and MCP tools for agents and offers guidance on when to use each approach.

items.title: Unlocking the Codex harness: how we built the App Server
items.title_zh: 解锁 Codex harness：我们如何构建 App Server
items.summary: OpenAI explains how to embed the Codex agent using the Codex App Server, a bidirectional JSON-RPC API that powers streaming progress, tool use, approvals and diffs.

items.title: Beyond agentic coding
items.title_zh: 超越智能体编程
items.summary: The author, who describes himself as generally pro-AI, argues that agentic coding has not improved his productivity in his experience and has eroded his comfort with and familiarity with the codebase.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows
items.title_zh: GitHub 智能体工作流
items.summary: GitHub's Agentic Workflows page describes AI-powered workflows in which Copilot, Claude, Codex or Antigravity agents triage issues, investigate failures and propose changes.

items.title: Snowflake and OpenAI partner to bring frontier intelligence to enterprise data
items.title_zh: Snowflake 与 OpenAI 合作，将前沿智能引入企业数据
items.summary: OpenAI and Snowflake announced a $200M agreement to bring frontier intelligence into enterprise data, enabling AI agents and insights directly inside Snowflake.

items.title: Introducing OpenAI Frontier
items.title_zh: 推出 OpenAI Frontier
items.summary: OpenAI Frontier is an enterprise platform for building, deploying and managing AI agents with shared context, onboarding, permissions and governance.
